title: Can I BEAT Shotgun King?
summary: First Shotgun King video: roguelike 'Shotgun King: The Final Checkmate'. You are the lone black king with a shotgun fighting the white army (traitors) floor by floor up the castle tower in Throne mode (goal floor 12). Tutorial: get the shotgun, avoid the white bishop, enter the castle. Between floors you take upgrade/curse cards.
rules: Board: 8x8 pixel chessboard per floor (tutorial uses a narrow 3-wide corridor).
Each turn the black king either moves one square (normal king move) or fires the shotgun.
Shotgun fires a spread/cone of pellets toward the aimed direction; enemy pieces have HP and may take several hits; uses shells; moving (or pressing Space) reloads a shell.
White pieces move by normal chess rules on their turn; squares they threaten are marked with '!'; if your king ends on an attacked square it is captured (game over).
Between floors choose cards: upgrades for you and curses/buffs for white (e.g. 'Charge one additional shell in your shotgun').
Kill the White King to clear the floor.
win_condition: Kill the White King on each floor; reach/clear floor 12 (Throne) to win the run.
